query: no-three-in-line problem large n constructions symmetry
title: No-three-in-line problem
highlight: Solutions with 2n points are known for every n up to 46; it is conjectured that for large n fewer than 2n points are possible. Most known solutions have some symmetry of the square.

title: Achim Flammenkamp: The No-Three-in-Line Problem
highlight: Configurations with 2n points restricted to symmetry classes (rotation by 180 degrees, reflections) were found by exhaustive branch and bound, which reduces the search space drastically.

title: A000769: No-3-in-line problem on n X n grid
highlight: Number of inequivalent ways of placing 2n points on an n X n grid so that no 3 are in a line.

query: incremental SAT lazy clause generation geometry
title: CaDiCaL SAT solver
highlight: CaDiCaL is a simplified satisfiability solver with incremental solving support: clauses can be added between calls without restarting.

query: Spencer six standard deviations discrepancy sign matrix
title: Discrepancy theory
highlight: Spencer showed that for n sets on n points there is a colouring with discrepancy at most 6 sqrt(n), improving the random bound by a log factor.

title: Paley construction
highlight: Paley constructions give Hadamard and conference matrices from quadratic residues in finite fields; they are natural high-discrepancy starting points.

title: Hadamard's maximal determinant problem
highlight: For n = 3 mod 4 the best known upper bound is due to Ehlich; record matrices for many orders come from block constructions and local search.

query: large determinant sign matrices table Orrick Solomon
title: Large-determinant sign matrices of order 4k+3
highlight: Tables of the largest known determinants of +-1 matrices by order, with constructions and references.

title: Sidon sequence
highlight: A Sidon set has all pairwise sums distinct. Erdos asked how large a Sidon subset must exist inside sets with few repeated differences.

query: two deletion correcting codes length 16 largest known
title: Deletion channel
highlight: Codes correcting s deletions; Varshamov-Tenengolts codes are optimal-ish for one deletion, while for two deletions the best sizes are found by clique search.

query: iterated local search maximum independent set conflict graph
title: Tabu search
highlight: Tabu search forbids recently visited moves for a tenure, letting a local search escape local optima; widely used for max-independent-set heuristics.

query: snake in the box dimension 13 longest known
title: Snake-in-the-box
highlight: The longest known snakes for dimensions 9 and above come from stochastic beam search and priming constructions.
